purpose: Teach: 途切れ/有り難い/延長線/掌/讃える/気がつけ/肴/本郷

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お話が、絶対、途切れた、絶対、ところから、絶対、続けてよ
lines.en: Mom, please — keep telling the story from where it stopped. I really need to know what happens next.
lines.style: Urgent, insistent, but not demanding. Quick breath intake. Eyes wide. Earnest desperation of a six-year-old who has to know now. Leans forward slightly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんからの、本気で、絶対、有り難い、絶対、お言葉、絶対、ママ、絶対、励みよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your grandfather's words were so kind, Sho. They really encouraged me.
lines.style: Soft, warm, speaking to him as though sharing something fragile and true. Slight pause before continuing — letting the weight of gratitude settle. A little vulnerable.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくの夢、本気で、絶対、お父さんの仕事の、絶対、延長線、絶対、上にあるかも
lines.en: My dream might be something that builds on what Dad does. Like it's connected.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Small pauses between phrases as if turning the idea over in his mind. Quiet wonder. Not asking, but thinking out loud. Voice trails slightly upward.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんの、本気で、絶対、掌、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、似てきたわよ
lines.en: You're starting to remind me of your father more and more, Sho.
lines.style: Tender observation, almost to herself. Soft smile in the voice. A little surprised by the realization. Warm and present, speaking the truth gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、ママの、絶対、お料理、絶対、讃える、絶対、よ
lines.en: I really want to praise Mom for her cooking, actually.
lines.style: Sincere, straightforward admiration. Small pride in his own observation. Not performing — genuinely meaning it. Slight emphasis on 'really.'

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 気がつけば、本気で、絶対、翔くん、絶対、もう、絶対、大きくなったわよね
lines.en: Before I knew it, you've grown up so much, haven't you?
lines.style: Wistful, slow realization in the voice. Tender and a little sad — the passing of time settling in. Soft, almost wondering at him. A mother noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お酒の肴、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、作ってあげてね
lines.en: Mom, make some good appetizers for Dad's sake next time, okay?
lines.style: Light and animated, but with genuine care underneath. Cheerful directive, not rude. Quick pace. The way a child gives practical instructions he thinks adults might forget.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今度、本気で、絶対、本郷の、絶対、お祖母さまのお墓、絶対、お参り、絶対、行きましょうね、翔くん
lines.en: Next time, let's go visit Grandma's grave in Hongo together, Sho.
lines.style: Gentle invitation, not a demand. Quiet tenderness. A mother including her son in something that matters. Slight warmth and invitation on his name at the end.
